scope: Additive Home Village TH18 reference delta for Super Archer Sharp Shot; it preserves every preceding reference artifact.
game_version: The immutable level payload is source commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The official TH18 announcement and secondary Sharp Shot table do not identify a current client build; that version remains explicitly unknown rather than inferred.

sources.limitations: The community table reports acquisition range 6, fixed projectile range 12, 1.5-second cadence and projectile penetration, but does not identify a client build or publish collision width, launch/impact timing, target-loss behavior, altitude boundary or exact hit ordering. It is secondary evidence only.

official_deltas.behavior: The February TH18 release adds Archer and Super Archer level 14. It does not specify Sharp Shot collision or timing.
The official maintenance note raises Super Archer HP at levels 10 through 13, but does not publish Sharp Shot geometry.

piercing_projectile_range_tiles.note: The secondary statistics table distinguishes 6-tile target acquisition from the fixed 12-tile Sharp Shot projectile range.

support.note: Core snapshots a straight 12-tile ray at launch and damages intersected opposing entities in ray order with entity-ID ties. The unmeasured collision radius, projectile flight timing, target loss, altitude boundary and visual fidelity remain explicitly unresolved.

changed_values.previous_state: catalogued-only Super Troop with no executable Sharp Shot behavior
changed_values.replacement: secondary-source fixed 12-tile piercing Sharp Shot through the shared deterministic projectile and snapshot path
changed_values.justification: The dated community table distinguishes target and projectile ranges and confirms penetration; official 2026 notices corroborate the TH18 level path without supplying the missing geometry contract.

known_uncertainties: The public sources do not publish projectile speed, launch/impact timing, target-loss behavior, target altitude filter, collision width or precise hitbox geometry.
Core currently uses its existing entity collision radii for line intersection and a logical T+10 ms impact; this is an explicit partial implementation, not a measured client contract.
No source-verified animation timing, sprite alignment or visual range-overlay measurement was found.
conclusion: This additive versioned reference does not alter the 2026-09-17 ledger or its preceding deltas.
